comment: FullyPlayableCreateACharacterSystemExperience (Create a Character System 3.21): who plays Cloud's place, on the CHARACTER page. Cloud stays the game's own; every character has its own CharaSpec rows, packs, blueprints, AI blueprint, weapons and voice (FullyPlayableCreateACharacterSystemExperience_P). Picking either Sephiroth also puts Evil Cloud in Sephiroth's place and Bizarro Sephiroth in Alexander's.

characters.name: YOUNG SEPHIROTH
characters.note: Young Sephiroth (Fully Playable Young Sephiroth): his own rows, blueprint, AI, Masamune, voice and forms; Evil Cloud takes Sephiroth's place and Bizarro Sephiroth Alexander's while he is picked

characters.name: SEPHIROTH
characters.note: Sephiroth (Fully Playable Sephiroth): the game's Sephiroth blueprint and Masamune on his own rows, his forms; Evil Cloud takes Sephiroth's place and Bizarro Sephiroth Alexander's while he is picked

characters.name: VINCENT
characters.note: Vincent (Fully Playable Vincent): his own rows, blueprint, AI, Quicksilver and voice; Dirge moves, Galian Beast and Chaos

characters.name: SORA
characters.note: Sora (Fully Playable Sora, KINGDOM HEARTS): his own rows on his own sets, his blueprints, Kingdom Key, voice
